en.headline: Firefighters extinguish flat blaze at Oi Tung Estate after evacuating more than 100…
en.dek: Police said a 17th-floor unit at Oi Chak House in Shau Kei Wan caught fire late on Monday night, with no injuries reported and the cause under investigation.
body: A fire broke out in a mid-floor flat at Oi Chak House, Oi Tung Estate in Shau Kei Wan on Monday night, prompting the evacuation of more than 100 residents.

Police received reports at around 10pm of smoke coming from a 17th-floor unit. Firefighters arrived quickly, forced entry after confirming the flat was unoccupied, and extinguished the blaze in about 12 minutes.
Thick smoke was visible from the building and the fire alarm sounded, with residents moving down the stairs to the ground floor. No injuries were reported, according to police and fire services.
The cause of the fire remains under investigation.

zh.headline: 筲箕灣愛東邨愛澤樓中層單位失火 逾百人疏散無人受傷
zh.dek: 警方稱周一晚上約10時愛澤樓17樓一單位起火冒煙，消防約12分鐘將火救熄，起火原因仍在調查。
body: 周一晚上，筲箕灣愛東邨愛澤樓一個中層單位發生火警，逾百名居民被疏散。
警方接獲多個報案，指晚上約10時愛澤樓17樓一單位起火冒煙。消防到場後確認單位內無人，破門入屋撲救，約12分鐘後將火救熄。
現場可見大廈中層冒出濃煙，火警鐘響起，大批住戶沿後樓梯下到地面暫避。警方及消防表示暫未有人受傷。
